_about: Each CI job's 'tests this' set: the repo paths whose behaviour the job specifically checks (read from its test script and the modules, programs and pages those assertions reach), not its closure. A pull request runs a job only when it changes a path in the job's set (or its family's _shared); main's full run after merge runs everything and is the backstop. 'paths' were read from the tests; 'widened' entries were added after a real failure in the history came from a change outside 'paths', each with the run that showed it. Globs are repo-relative in today's tree; a plain path also covers everything under it.

systems.notes: node1 and node2 toplevels on every runner (main's full run only). FAIL TO BUILD: a module eval error; Rust compile of dd/git-remote-dd/verify/release/games/computers/transcode and the wasm builds (client/web, client/mail); dd-control's `go test ./...` in its checkPhase (any servers/system/control package test failing breaks every system) and Go vendorHash drift (servers/system/control/go.{mod,sum}, app/net/go.{mod,sum}); patches that stop applying (servers/photos/*.patch, servers/vault/*.patch, nix/overlays/fhsenv-tie.patch, nix/patches/*); sops-nix's build-time check that every declared secret is in secrets/<box>.yaml; nginx config validation in the NixOS nginx module (gixy). MERELY MOVES drvPath: pages/docs/data/the-joke/servers/*/web copies, unit .sh/.py scripts read as text by ddScript, fleet JSON values that are only interpolated. DIFFER BETWEEN BOXES (systems_agree): evaluation is pure and from the same commit (no currentTime/getEnv/IFD in box modules), so a disagreement means the builders evaluated differently: a different nix on a runner (the box's running release: flake.lock / forge runner module), a status recorded late or twice (.forgejo/workflows/entry_point.yml paging), not anything in a box module. Byte-level reproducibility is dd-attest's at publish, not this job's.

flake.notes: Evaluation fails on: a nix syntax/type/option error in anything flake.nix reaches (all modules, roles, lib, tests, controller, installer); a missing path literal (./x that was moved/deleted); JSON/TOML that does not parse or lacks a key the nix reads (fleet/*, Cargo manifests, bundles.json, Cargo.lock); asserts/throws (cargo-nix Cargo.nix vs Cargo.lock, placement, needs-units, boxes, dns-worker gateways); the date step. evalChecks BUILD (not just evaluate) registry.eval: plaintext-label, boxes, box-reports, ci, ci-select, stylesheet, cargo-nix, nginx (nginx -t per box), usage-facts, fleet-defaults, retention, terms-version, needs-units, placement, safe-rd, runner-capacity, cache-trust, placement-fleet, pdf-editor (builds the wasm web bundle), calendar-js, git-path. Gap: eval=false for a PR made only of servers|client|app .rs/.go (SOURCE_ONLY), yet retention reads servers/gate/src/leaving.rs + servers/library/src/dav.rs, and pdf-editor builds client/web; those changes skip flake_check in a PR (client/identity is FOUNDATION so it runs). Prose-only files (README/docs) other than docs/policies/terms.md cannot fail it.
